 Judgment
The present appeal has been filed by the claimant seeking to enhance the award passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal in M.C.O.P.No.211 of 2009.
2. According to the claimants, he had sustained multiple fracture in the right leg and grievous injuries in the hip portion.
As per Exhibit P.2, the injured claimant had sustained 40% disability.
The tribunal has awarded Rs.2,000/- per percentage.
According to the appellant, it should be enhanced to Rs.3,000/- per month.

3. The learned counsel appearing for the claimant had further contended that the claimant was admitted in hospital as an in-patient 9 times on various dates from August 2008 to July 2012,
totally 174 days.
Therefore, the tribunal was not right in awarding just Rs.10,000/- towards pain and suffering.
He further contended that the tribunal has awarded only Rs.5,000/- towards extra nourishment.
He had further contended that the tribunal has not awarded any amount towards future https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis medical expenses, attender charges and loss of amenities.
Hence, he prayed enhancement of the award under the above heads.

4. Per contra, the learned counsel appearing for the respondent had contended that the injured claimant had been admitted on the hospital on several occasions and the entire hospital bill has been accepted by the tribunal and a sum of Rs.4,41,000/- has been awarded under the head of medical expenses.
Therefore, there is no scope for any enhancement towards future medical expenses.
He further contended that the accident has taken place in the year 2008 and the tribunal was right in awarding Rs.2,000/- per percentage.
Hence, he prayed that the award of the tribunal may be confirmed.
5. I have carefully considered the submissions made on either side and perused the medical records.

6. A perusal of the medical records, namely the discharge summary under Exhibits P.11, P.14, P.17,
P.20, P.22, P.25, P.28, P.30 and P.34 would clearly reveal that the injured claimant was admitted to the hospital on 9 occasions for undergoing treatment on right hip.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Discharge Summary under Exhibit P.30 also reveals that there was a right total hip replacement for the claimant on 24.02.2011.
Considering the above said facts, it is manifest that the claimant has sustained very grievous injuries and has undergone hip replacement surgery also.
7. Considering the nature of the injuries sustained by the claimant, this Court is inclined to award Rs.3,000/- per percentage for the disability.
Therefore, the total amount under the head of disability would be at Rs.1,20,000/- in stead of Rs.80,000/-.The
tribunal
has awarded Rs.10,000/- towards pain and suffering.

Considering the fact that the claimant was admitted as an in-patient for nearly 174 days on various occasions, this Court is inclined to enhance the award amount towards pain and suffering as Rs.1,00,000/-.
The tribunal has awarded just Rs.5,000/- towards extra nourishment and this Court is inclined to enhance it to Rs.50,000/-.
The tribunal has not awarded any amount as attender charges.
Considering the fact that the claimant was an in-patient for nearly 174 days, this Court is inclined to award Rs.25,000/- towards attender charges.
It is a case of hip replacement.

Therefore, towards future medical expenses, this Court is inclined to award Rs.1,00,000/-.

As per the discharge summary, it is clear that there is shortening of leg.
Therefore, this Court is inclined to award a sum of Rs.25,000/- towards loss of amenities.
The award of the tribunal under the other heads remain undisturbed.
8. In view of the above said deliberations, the award amount is modified as follows:

Permanent partial disability : Rs.1,20,000/-
 Pain and suffering : Rs.1,00,000/-

Extra nourishment : Rs. 50,000/-
 Transport : Rs. 34,400/-
Medical expenses : Rs.4,41,000/-
Future medical expenses : Rs.1,00,000/-
Attender charges : Rs. 25,000/-
The award amount of Rs.5,70,400/- is hereby enhanced to Rs.8,95,400/- (Rupees Eight Lakh Ninety Five Thousand and Four https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Hundred only).
The enhanced amount will carry 7.5% interest from the date of the claim petition.
The insurance company is directed to deposit the enhanced amount within a period of eight (8) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
10. The Civil Miscellaneous Appeal stands allowed to the extent as stated above.
The decree shall be drafted by the High Court only after deposit of the deficit Court fee.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Civil Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
